  BackendActivityEvent (packages/ui-sdk/src/server/backend.ts)
    export type BackendActivityEvent = {
        kind: "subagent_started";
        toolUseId: string;
        taskId?: string;
        subagentType?: string;
        description?: string;
        depth?: number;
    } | {
        kind: "subagent_status";
        toolUseId: string;
        status: "running" | "completed" | "failed" | "killed" | "paused";
        usage?: {
            totalTokens?: number;
            toolUses?: number;
            durationMs?: number;
        };
        summary?: string;
    } | {
        kind: "subagent_transcript";
        toolUseId: string;
        role: "assistant" | "user";
        text: string;
    } | {
        kind: "permission_denied";
        toolUseId: string;
        requestKind: "tool" | "command";
        reason: string;
    } | {
        kind: "runtime_observed";
        runtime?: {
            name: string;
            version: string;
        };
        sdk?: {
            name: string;
            version: string;
        };
        credential?: Record<string, string>;
        billing: BillingMode | "unknown";
        policy?: BillingMode;
        policyViolation?: string;
        measured?: boolean;
    } | {
        kind: "auth_failure";
        errorClass: string;
        message?: string;
    };

    }
